item.title: Reach an iMessage or SMS group by its participants
item.summary: From your private Murph conversation, you can again ask or hand off to a joined iMessage or SMS group by describing who is in it instead of knowing its exact title.
item.details: Murph uses the people or group size you provide only to resolve one iMessage or SMS group it has already joined. It does not list your memberships, expose group identifiers, or include you in the participant description.
